rows.label: -sn
rows.value: Host discovery only — no port scan. Use for discovery sweeps.

rows.label: -PE
rows.value: ICMP Echo Request probe. Standard ping — fast, often blocked.

rows.label: -PS [ports]
rows.value: TCP SYN probe to specified ports. Example: -PS80,443

rows.label: -PA [ports]
rows.value: TCP ACK probe to specified ports. Example: -PA80

rows.label: -Pn
rows.value: Skip host discovery — treat all hosts as up. Last resort only.

rows.label: --reason
rows.value: Show why Nmap marked a host up or down (echo-reply, syn-ack, reset)

rows.label: -T4
rows.value: Timing: fast (professional default)

rows.label: -T2
rows.value: Timing: polite (slower, quieter — for sensitive networks)

rows.label: -oA [filename]
rows.value: Save output in all formats: normal, XML, grepable

sections.heading: Discovery Commands — In Order of Use

rows.label: Step 1: Default sweep
rows.value: nmap -sn -oA host-discovery 45.77.180.0/24

rows.label: Host is up (reason: echo-reply)
rows.value: ICMP Echo Request got a reply — host confirmed alive

rows.label: Host is up (reason: syn-ack)
rows.value: TCP SYN got SYN/ACK — port open and host alive

rows.label: Host is up (reason: reset)
rows.value: TCP SYN got RST — port closed but host alive

rows.label: No response (timeout)
rows.value: Ambiguous — could be offline OR filtering probes. Try TCP next.

rows.label: Host seems down
rows.value: Nmap's phrasing when all default probes fail — NOT a confirmed offline status

rows.label: 1. Check scope
rows.value: Confirm which IPs are authorised before sending any probe

rows.label: 2. Default sweep
rows.value: nmap -sn [range] — ICMP + TCP combined

rows.label: 3. Follow up
rows.value: TCP probes on any expected-live host that did not respond

rows.label: 4. Document
rows.value: Note every result: IP, probe type, response, latency, timestamp

rows.label: 5. Build the list
rows.value: Confirmed live hosts become the input for all port scans

rows.label: P — Probe first
rows.value: Send discovery packets before any port scan

rows.label: I — Interpret carefully
rows.value: No reply ≠ offline. ICMP filtering is common.

rows.label: N — Note everything
rows.value: Method, response, latency, timestamp — all of it

rows.label: G — Go targeted
rows.value: Scan only confirmed live hosts
